collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two teens aged 14-17)

collection.description: A teen stands on the high rock above the lagoon for the first time: jump, or climb back down.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At the lagoon there is a high rock that the older teens jump from into the deep water. It's safe, if you jump straight out. (subject) has climbed up today for the first time, and (subject.he/she) is standing at the edge, looking down. It looks much higher from up here. Below, (subject.his/her) friends are shouting, "Jump! Jump!" (friend) is standing beside (subject.him/her).

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) jumps. For one long moment there's nothing but air and (subject.his/her) own yell. Then the water swallows (subject.him/her), cold and green, and (subject.he/she) comes up gasping and laughing. Everyone cheers. (subject.He/she) climbs straight back up to do it again. The fear was real. (subject.He/she) jumped anyway, and (subject.he/she) doesn't think that makes the fear any less real.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Not today," says (subject). (subject.He/she) climbs back down the way (subject.he/she) came up. One or two friends call out. (friend) climbs down too and says to them, "Leave it." The rock will still be there. Maybe next summer. Maybe never. (subject) swims in the lagoon all afternoon and has a wonderful time.
